question: Can a whole Sapling policy update using actual sampled returns from complete games improve its normal deployed greedy decisions and transfer to original Master3s2?
reference: Starting package has won 2/20 against the full original on 10 first-use development maps; mean official margin -1164.13. Those games and all official-exam reservations stay out of all map sets in this experiment.
lineup: Keep the 75% self-owned it50 and 25% Sapling blended decoder, quantization, late collector residual and its safety routing. Only Sapling policy tensors may change at export. Reference opponents are self-owned operational packages at it20 (Echo4), it40 and it50, all frozen separately with digests in opponents.json. No Master3s2 stepwise move, teacher logit, original outcome, public ladder outcome or future state is a training input for this update.

collection.schedule: Ascending map index modulo three selects the frozen opponent in order it20, it40, it50; both learner seats and both arms per map, total 72. Use 36 sampled trajectories and 36 paired greedy baselines. Simultaneous actions, actual official conditional rules, terminal extinction or full game. Keep all draws and defeats, IDs, initial board, score, configuration, full actions, sampler and opponent signatures.
collection.behavior: Use the existing training-only onpolicy_native binary sampler at these turns. Both orders must be legal after actual-prefix redecoding and guards. The second is a genuine alternative with logit gap at most 1; sample relative to the exact mixed logits. If no eligible worker, emit the unaltered full joint order and record the missed opportunity. Original ordinary actor for all other turns. Save sampled probability, support, draw, actual order, and seed for verification. Greedy arm always executes unmodified 8da4.

learning.objective: W=1 for win, 0.5 for draw, 0 for loss. U=0.5*W+0.5*sigmoid(official_margin/1000). A=U(sampled)-U(greedy) matching map, learner physical seat and opponent.
learning.update: One on-policy full-batch likelihood-ratio gradient for the Sapling policy backbone and decoder. Keep partner, reward and value heads fixed. For each trajectory sum A times the chosen conditional log probabilities of supported choices; use equal map and seat weights and one uniform normalization constant. One AdamW update, zero weight decay, lr=0.0001, gradient norm clip=1. No validation or arena result selects the learning rate or number of updates.
learning.parity: Reconstruct real pre-action histories, safety route, unit prefix and physical command. At every fitted draw require parent Torch vs observed physical binary signed logit-difference error <=0.003 and probability error <=0.00075. Verify all archive signatures, finite gradient, changed deployed quantized tensors and changed free joint commands including a change in each seat on training evidence before playing development. Physical negative results remain in the ledger.

development.schedule: Six different cleared maps, each played with both seats by greedy frozen parent and updated package, two maps per opponent in same order, 24 full scored games. Separately record per-seat and per-opponent scores, all actions, natural sampling context, map-level differences and uncertainty.
development.advance: Mean paired official-margin gain positive, wins at least parent, positive mean margin difference on at least four of six physical maps and at least two of three opponent identities. If this and actual deployed changes pass, freeze and time the single file on the ladder limits and examine two preregistered new original-development maps both seats against the unmodified original, paired against the parent on the same host. Apply native search/wall-clock verification. These tests do not count toward the independent 200.

formal: No formal exam or public submission in this experiment. Formal target later uses 100 previously unused maps fixed after candidate freeze, both seats, at least 180 wins and mean official margin >=500 in the same 200 games with platform qualification.
